$comment: Canonical MCP configuration for GitHub Copilot cloud agent and Copilot code review.
THIS FILE IS NOT READ BY ANYTHING AT RUNTIME. The repository-level cloud-agent MCP
configuration lives in repository settings on GitHub.com (Settings > Copilot > MCP
servers) and there is no supported repository file or REST API that sets it. This
file is the version-controlled source of truth for what SHOULD be pasted there, so
that the setting is reviewable, diffable, and attributable to a commit instead of
existing only as unversioned UI state.
To apply: copy the mcpServers object below (without these $comment keys, which are
not part of the schema) into Settings > Copilot > MCP servers, and save.
Pin discipline: the version below is exact and must stay in agreement with the
adrkit commit pinned by scripts/validate-queue.sh. Never use @latest or a floating
range here -- see README.md, 'Pinned adrkit commit'. scripts/validate-mcp.sh fails
the build when this file, .vscode/mcp.json, and .copilot/mcp-config.json disagree.
Tool allowlist: the four tools are enumerated rather than using ['*']. Copilot uses
MCP tools autonomously without asking for approval, so the allowlist is a real
boundary, and enumerating it means an upstream release that adds a fifth tool
cannot silently widen what agents in this repository can call.
